title: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139
summary: Crashes when the first video starts. Its video is WMV2 with WMA v2 audio in ASF, which no CrossOver decodes; the fix decodes it itself where the engine cannot.

excerpts.note: The game asks for decode into D3D video textures; the reader gets a copy of its attributes without the two that ask for it, so it decodes in software.

cause: The game asks Media Foundation to decode the WMV2 video into D3D video textures; under D3DMetal there is nothing to decode into, and it dies asking for NV12 output.
